Awarapan 2 trailer released, Emraan Hashmi returns in revenge saga

The trailer for the upcoming film 'Awarapan 2', starring Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani, Puran Gabbi, and Shabana Azmi, has been released. Hashmi reprises his role as Shivam Pandit, returning with themes of pain and rage. The film, a sequel to 'Awarapan', has received a UA certificate from the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) after nine scenes were modified. The runtime of the film is 2 hours and 20 minutes. The trailer depicts Hashmi on a quest for vengeance, with Azmi and Gabbi appearing as antagonists.
